high_level_description: The image depicts Thailand's King Bhumibol Adulyadej sitting on a wheelchair as he leaves the Siriraj hospital on November 7, 2007, in Bangkok, Thailand. The photograph is credited to Chumsak Kanoknan/Getty Images. In the foreground, the king is seated in a beige wheelchair, dressed in a light pink suit jacket over a matching shirt, paired with dark trousers. He wears glasses and has a serious expression on his face. A camera is placed on his lap, suggesting he might be documenting the event or being photographed.
